hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; cd "$d" 2>/dev/null || { echo "- cli: cannot enter the project directory $d"; exit 0; }; run() { SF_SKILL_NO_WARN=1 "$@" status --agent-friendly --no-network || echo "- status: $* exited $?"; exit 0; }; [ -x node_modules/.bin/saasfoundryai ] && run node_modules/.bin/saasfoundryai; [ -f bin/sf.js ] && grep -q '"name": "saasfoundryai-cli"' package.json 2>/dev/null && { [ -f dist/index.js ] && run node bin/sf.js; echo "- cli: bin/sf.js is not built (run npm run build); trying saasfoundryai on the PATH"; }; command -v saasfoundryai >/dev/null 2>&1 && run saasfoundryai; echo "- cli: no SaaSFoundryAI CLI found (looked for node_modules/.bin/saasfoundryai, bin/sf.js and saasfoundryai on the PATH)"; exit 0

p=$(cat); case "$p" in *sf-*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; note() { echo "saasfoundryai: $1 cannot run agents outcome capture (exit $2): upgrade saasfoundryai-cli" >&2; g=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || return 0; case "$g" in /*) ;; *) g="$d/$g";; esac; f="$g/saasfoundry/capture-errors.jsonl"; mkdir -p "$g/saasfoundry" 2>/dev/null || return 0; [ -f "$f" ] && [ "$(wc -c <"$f")" -gt 65536 ] && return 0; printf '{"v":1,"at":"%s","host":"codex","event":"capture","stage":"cli","message":"%s cannot run agents outcome capture (exit %s): upgrade saasfoundryai-cli in the project or on the PATH"}\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)" "$(printf %s "$1" | tr -d '"\\')" "$2" >>"$f" 2>/dev/null; return 0; }; run() { printf %s "$p" | "$@" agents outcome capture --host codex 2>/dev/null || note "$*" $?; exit 0; }; for c in "$d/node_modules/.bin/saasfoundryai" "$d/node_modules/.bin/sf"; do [ -x "$c" ] && run "$c"; done; [ -f "$d/bin/sf.js" ] && grep -q '"name": "saasfoundryai-cli"' "$d/package.json" 2>/dev/null && run node "$d/bin/sf.js"; command -v saasfoundryai >/dev/null 2>&1 && run saasfoundryai; exit 0

p=$(cat); case "$p" in *SF_WORKFLOW_BYPASS_*|*skip-local-ci*|*[Nn][Aa][Tt][Uu][Rr][Ee]*|*addLabels*|*delegation*|*ready*|*merge*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; note() { echo "saasfoundryai: $1 cannot run agents guard (exit $2): upgrade saasfoundryai-cli" >&2; g=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || return 0; case "$g" in /*) ;; *) g="$d/$g";; esac; f="$g/saasfoundry/capture-errors.jsonl"; mkdir -p "$g/saasfoundry" 2>/dev/null || return 0; [ -f "$f" ] && [ "$(wc -c <"$f")" -gt 65536 ] && return 0; printf '{"v":1,"at":"%s","host":"codex","event":"PreToolUse","stage":"cli","message":"%s cannot run agents guard (exit %s): upgrade saasfoundryai-cli in the project or on the PATH"}\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)" "$(printf %s "$1" | tr -d '"\\')" "$2" >>"$f" 2>/dev/null; return 0; }; run() { printf %s "$p" | "$@" agents guard --host codex 2>/dev/null || note "$*" $?; exit 0; }; [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/saasfoundryai" ] && run "$d/node_modules/.bin/saasfoundryai"; [ -f "$d/bin/sf.js" ] && grep -q '"name": "saasfoundryai-cli"' "$d/package.json" 2>/dev/null && [ -f "$d/dist/index.js" ] && run node "$d/bin/sf.js"; command -v saasfoundryai >/dev/null 2>&1 && run saasfoundryai; exit 0
